representations.name: owned-diagonal to reserve-candidate bipartite graph
representations.new_information: Left vertices are distinct missing-A owner atoms, right vertices are actual missing-B edges not already reserved by the circuit, and adjacency records a specific minimum-degree/rectangle forcing witness from the A edge endpoints to that B edge.
representations.repairs_loss: Restores the missing carrier-level A-to-B conversion and forbids rho_A+rho_B without a matching.
representations.first_test: Build the n=14 three-colour/two-token tight graph and compute every candidate B edge generated by each of x_i y_i; kill if all three left atoms have the same empty or singleton neighbourhood.
representations.nearest_easy_comparator: One coherent opposite star with disjoint leaf endpoint pairs and a complete common rectangle.
representations.public_effect: A matching covering the B deficit proves D_B<=M_B without untyped addition.

representations.name: alternating typed reserve rerouting network
representations.new_information: Retain the current colour-to-B reservation, unused B atoms, owned A atoms, and explicit conversion arcs so an A atom can open an augmenting path rather than being counted as a B unit.
representations.repairs_loss: Distinguishes new B capacity from a relabelling or double use of an existing reserve edge.
representations.first_test: Use the common two-token reserve circuit and test whether one converted atom creates a genuine augmenting path or only cycles among the two occupied tokens.
representations.nearest_easy_comparator: A Hall-tight circuit with one external reserve edge.
representations.public_effect: One augmentation per deficient colour closes the B reserve gate.

representations.name: cross-star owned-rectangle quotient hypergraph
representations.new_information: Hyperedges retain a coherent star, its distinct diagonal owners, the whole anticomplete X-by-Y rectangle, and equality classes of A pairs shared by other stars.
representations.repairs_loss: Quotients diagonal overlap before any conversion and keeps the nonlinear rectangle host that scalar rho_A discards.
representations.first_test: Glue two stars along one diagonal while keeping their other endpoints disjoint; reject any rule that emits two target atoms from the shared diagonal without separate rectangle witnesses.
representations.nearest_easy_comparator: A sunflower of rectangles with disjoint petals and one shared A diagonal.
representations.public_effect: A bounded-overlap transversal converts the union of owned rectangles to distinct target atoms.

representations.name: two-sided minimum-degree transport relation
representations.new_information: For every owned pair xy, retain the actual B-neighbour sets forced separately by the missing Y-neighbours of x and missing X-neighbours of y, with target edges represented as ordered endpoint pairs before deduplication.
representations.repairs_loss: Refines the scalar rectangle inequality x(y-g)_+ + y(x-g)_+ into a candidate map whose collisions can be measured.
representations.first_test: On rectangular blow-ups with degree spread g, enumerate whether many owned diagonals force the same cross edge or yield distinct missing-B pairs.
representations.public_effect: A uniform congestion bound turns rectangle size into spendable B reserve.

representations.name: edge-ledger slack atom complex
representations.new_information: Represent every term of S_m=e-binom(|B|,2)-Phi(n,e) by a signed cell indexed by an actual graph edge, missing pair, or compatible-colour certificate, and seek cancellations leaving named positive slack atoms.
representations.repairs_loss: Replaces anonymous scalar S_m units by carriers with owner sets and makes negative terms explicit.
representations.first_test: Apply the proposed cancellation to the audited tight/paid n=14 swap pair; identical S_m must yield valid atom sets in both graphs without silently exchanging an A edge for a B edge.
representations.nearest_easy_comparator: A complete bipartite extremal graph plus one internal edge.
representations.public_effect: An atom set of size S_m can receive outer-A demand through Hall.

representations.name: colour-owned low-edge cancellation ledger
representations.new_information: Keep each low internal edge, its colour, the unique high anchor when present, the N_int cancellation credit, and the resulting uncancelled outer-A atom instead of retaining only R_A.
representations.repairs_loss: Restores the provenance erased in e(A_<q*)+I_mix-N_int and makes ownership of the residue auditable.
representations.first_test: Enumerate all one-colour profiles from the mixed-high identity and require the atomization to commute with merging two colours that share an internal-low endpoint.
representations.nearest_easy_comparator: A wholly low internal colour class, where all but one edge cancel canonically.
representations.public_effect: A matching from uncancelled outer-A atoms into slack carriers proves R_A<=S_m.

representations.name: slack-owner coverage rank
representations.new_information: Given a candidate slack atomization, record precommitted colour/circuit owner neighbourhoods and the coverage rank rho_S(T), including equality classes of atoms shared across stars.
representations.repairs_loss: Prevents the same S_m unit from paying several outer-A or circuit demands.
representations.first_test: Use two circuits requesting the same sole slack atom; local capacity passes but the union rank must expose deficit one.
representations.nearest_easy_comparator: Disjoint circuits with disjoint atom owners.
representations.public_effect: Hall for rho_S supplies an overlap-safe outer-A payment.

representations.name: anchored outer-A compatible-edge complex
representations.new_information: Join internal-low A edges, unique mixed high anchors, owned diagonals, and their common-C7 compatibility witnesses in one labelled complex at the canonical q* threshold.
representations.repairs_loss: Forces the B-circuit and outer-A witnesses to live in the same graph and colour classes rather than combining separately optimized scalars.
representations.first_test: Insert the three-colour tight circuit into the n=14 graph and determine whether its owned diagonals meet the actual A_<q* complex or lie completely outside it.
representations.nearest_easy_comparator: Branch A with D_B already paid and I_mix=0.
representations.public_effect: Either the complex emits Phi(n,e) compatible distinct colours or proves R_A<=S_m directly.

representations.name: outer-A deficit blocker dual
representations.new_information: Encode a failure of R_A<=S_m as a minimal labelled blocker consisting of uncancelled low-edge atoms and unavailable slack carriers, with each block retaining its colour and high anchor.
representations.repairs_loss: Turns the scalar excess R_A-S_m into a minimal object on which an owned rectangle or compatible-colour exit can act.
representations.first_test: Classify blockers of size at most four and reject any uncrossing that changes the high anchor or reuses one missing pair in two blocks.
representations.nearest_easy_comparator: A single wholly low colour with exactly one uncancelled edge.
representations.public_effect: Eliminating every blocker proves the outer-A gate in all hard branches.

representations.name: typed conversion polymatroid intersection
representations.new_information: Keep rho_A, rho_B and any proved rho_S as separate ranks, together with an explicit bipartite conversion relation; feasibility is an intersection/flow problem, never the scalar sum of ranks.
representations.repairs_loss: Preserves both resource type and overlap while exposing a dual deficient set if conversion fails.
representations.first_test: Instantiate the audited three-colour/two-B-token circuit with three A owners and no conversion arcs; the rank oracle must remain infeasible despite total scalar rank five.
representations.nearest_easy_comparator: The same circuit after adding one external B atom adjacent to every A owner.
representations.public_effect: A typed intersection theorem simultaneously pays B demand and outer-A demand without double spending.

representations.name: laminar tight-circuit conversion forest
representations.new_information: Represent minimal Hall circuits, shared B reserve atoms, shared A owners, and rectangle containment as a forest after uncrossing only operations that preserve typed carriers.
representations.repairs_loss: Tracks cross-circuit overlap and makes every merge or conversion decrease a bounded typed deficit potential.
representations.first_test: Use two crossing tight circuits with one shared B token and one shared A diagonal; test whether a laminar replacement preserves both owner maps.
representations.nearest_easy_comparator: Nested circuits with strictly increasing reserve unions.
representations.public_effect: Termination with no circuit gives a global reserve assignment; a terminal circuit must trigger the outer gate.
